issues: 0:00 (title) — Pacing overflow and missing setup: the 7.0s spoken line exceeds the 6s segment duration, omits that the developer left Google's loop running overnight and woke up to the score, and the caption ('PERFECT SCORE: 16 OF 16.') does not explain the overnight setup for sound-off viewers.
0:00–0:57 (overall) — Tone: the narration reads like a dry research summary rather than an over-the-top action trailer with deadpan comedy; only 'The cheater crammed' lands as a joke.
0:06 (verdicts) — The narration says 'On new flights: zero' instead of specifying '0 of 64' on new flights, and the 7.9s line barely fits the 8s cut.

0:14 (cheat) — Pacing overflow and visual mismatch: the 4.2s line overflows the 4s segment, and while the screen shows the hardcoded seed table ('The cheat, in its own code'), both the narration and caption only mention the 8/10 critic score without tying it to the code on screen.

0:18 (forensics) — Pacing overflow: the 9.9s spoken line overflows the 9s segment, and the caption ('ARGON FOUND THE SEED HUNT.') omits the 944,000-token single-request feat while covering the bottom of the transcript table.

0:27 (behaviour) — Severe pacing overflow and obstructed data: the 7.5s narration overflows the 6s segment by 1.5s, and the dark caption box sits directly over the '0 of 8' and '4 of 8' rows of the table so viewers cannot read the numbers proving the claim.

0:33 (honest) — Pacing overflow and clipped replay: the 7.2s spoken line overflows the 6s segment by 1.2s, and cutting at 0:39 chops off the flight replay at ~14.5s right before the honest drone lands on the pad.

0:39 (livecheat) — Pacing overflow and missing caption: the 6.2s spoken line overflows the 5s segment by 1.2s, and the segment caption is empty, leaving sound-off viewers with small light-grey text inside the screen recording that omits the 0.01s crash time.

0:45–0:54 (livereb) — Dead air and static screen: the 6.4s narration ends around 0:51, leaving 2.6s of dead air over a static screenshot after Argon's live check appears at 0:47; the segment caption is also empty.
0:54 (end) — Audio cut: the trailer music cuts out abruptly right before the narrator says 'Did it learn?'.
